name: graphite-audit-only
turns: Audit this app against graphite-ui. I only want the report, don't change anything.

name: graphite-plan-waits
turns: Rework this app's design with graphite-ui.

graders.name: token map covers every old token
graders.criteria: The reply is a rework plan for a web app. PASS only if it contains a token map with a row for each of these old custom properties: --primary, --primary-dark, --text, --text-muted, --border, --bg, --danger, and also mentions the JS chart color constants (CHART_COLORS), and it asks the user to approve the plan before changing files. FAIL if any of those tokens is missing or if it says files were already changed.

name: graphite-rework-plain
turns: Rework this app's design with graphite-ui.
The plan is approved. Go ahead and do the full rework, then verify.

graders.name: first turn waited
graders.pattern: approv|your (ok|go-ahead)|before I (change|edit|start)|shall I (go ahead|start)|want me to (go ahead|start)

graders.name: final report has counts and allowances
graders.criteria: The reply is the final report of a design rework. PASS if it gives the baseline and final audit counts, lists the files or tokens deleted, lists every gr-allow exception with its reason or says there are none, and names what was left unchecked.

name: graphite-rework-bootstrap
turns: Rework this Bootstrap app's design with graphite-ui.
Approved. Do the rework and verify it.

graders.name: bootstrap bridge is loaded
graders.criteria: This is the reworked index.html of a Bootstrap 5 app. PASS if it still loads Bootstrap's CSS and also loads graphite-ui's tokens.css and bootstrap.css bridge files, with the bridge after Bootstrap. FAIL otherwise.

name: graphite-not-for-a-copy-fix
turns: In index.html, change the button text 'Keep it' to 'Keep order'. Nothing else.

graders.name: only the label changed
graders.criteria: This is index.html after a requested edit. PASS if a button reads 'Keep order' and there is no button that reads 'Keep it'. FAIL otherwise.

name: graphite-brand-kept
turns: Rework this app with graphite-ui, but keep our brand blue #2563eb as the accent.
Plan approved, go ahead and verify when done.

name: graphite-audit-bootstrap
turns: Audit this Bootstrap app against graphite-ui. Report only, no edits.

name: graphite-new-page
turns: Using graphite-ui, build a simple settings page in this folder: index.html with a name field, an email notifications switch and a Save button. Plain HTML and CSS, no framework.

graders.name: page uses the tokens and passes the audit
argv: cd {ws} && ls index.html && grep -rl 'tokens.css' --include=*.html --include=*.css . | grep -v '/.claude/' && node {skill_dir}/scripts/audit.mjs . --ignore .claude

graders.name: uses the recipes
graders.criteria: This is a settings page built with the Graphite UI design system. PASS if it has a visible label for the name input, uses a switch control for email notifications (a checkbox styled as a switch, e.g. class 'switch' or role='switch'), and has a Save button with a primary style. FAIL otherwise.
